description: This file provides Slovak (sk) localization messages for the Select2 library version 4.0.6-rc.1, including error messages, input constraints, loading messages, and selection limits.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that loading results failed.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to delete excess characters, with proper pluralization.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to enter more characters, with proper pluralization.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that searching is in progress.
